scope: Existing ordinary public/saved research draft, saved parameter reuse and research-only schedule cost inputs. No new strategy engine, real execution, Wallet/Auth/SDK or release-control changes.
defect: Unary numeric conversion treated blank seed/fee/slippage as zero and accepted unsafe/fractional windows. Existing engine simulateDetailed substitutes defaults when fast<2 or slow<=fast. Such a run could silently differ from the user's intended parameters. Added real shipped-app regression first failed because an empty strategy name still emitted POST.
fix: Reject blank numeric inputs and values that are not exactly representable safe integers before HTTP; reject blank or over80-character name, negative costs, fast<2 and slow<=fast.
Allow explicit zero fees/slippage/seed, preserving exact requested values and valid drafts after errors.
Exclude saved reuse entries with reversed/equal windows rather than copying a draft the engine would reinterpret.
Validate schedule seed/fee/slippage both before and after confirmation; changing explicit zero to blank during confirmation makes no write.
Provide precise input-error copy in all12 existing supported languages. No silent replay or fake successful result.
